meetings.title: Pension consultant conference
meetings.summary: Connected with Mateo Tanaka at the pension consultant conference. Discussed the in-flight Capital Group US Core Equity RFP and Northgate's evolving US equity allocation; Tanaka signalled the committee wants the fee picture clarified before advancing.

decisions.text: Northgate will keep evaluating the US Core Equity mandate pending a fee proposal.

action_items.text: Prepare fee proposal for the US Core Equity mandate

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Mateo Tanaka
transcript_excerpt.text: We like the US Core Equity story, but the committee will want the fee picture spelled out.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Marcus Hale
transcript_excerpt.text: Understood - I'll get a fee proposal over to you next week.

meetings.title: Mandate funding logistics
meetings.summary: Call with John Sato on funding logistics for the EuroPacific Growth relationship and the prospective US Core Equity mandate. Holding for the consultant's feedback before next steps.

action_items.text: Await consultant feedback on funding sequencing

transcript_excerpt.speaker: John Sato
transcript_excerpt.text: Once our consultant signs off we can move quickly on funding.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Marcus Hale
transcript_excerpt.text: Great - I'll stand by and pre-stage the paperwork.
